description: This is a PHP unit test class for the OAuthToken component of the SuiteCRM application, containing multiple test methods for OAuthToken functionalities.

classes.name: OAuthTokenTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing OAuthToken functionalities within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test method.

methods.name: test__construct
methods.description: Tests the constructor and initial property values of OAuthToken.

methods.name: testsetState
methods.description: Tests setting the state of an OAuthToken.

methods.name: testsetConsumer
methods.description: Tests setting the consumer and consumer object of an OAuthToken.

methods.name: testsetCallbackURL
methods.description: Tests setting the callback URL of an OAuthToken.

methods.name: testgenerate
methods.description: Tests the static generate method of OAuthToken.

methods.name: testSaveAndOthers
methods.description: Tests saving, loading, invalidating, authorizing, and deleting OAuthTokens.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an OAuthToken by ID and asserts its existence.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates an OAuthToken and checks its state.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Tests the authorization process of an OAuthToken.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks an OAuthToken as deleted and verifies it cannot be loaded.

methods.name: testcreateAuthorized
methods.description: Tests creating an authorized OAuthToken with associated OAuthKey and User objects.

methods.name: copyAuthData
methods.description: Copies authentication data from one OAuthToken to another.

methods.name: testqueryString
methods.description: Tests the queryString method of OAuthToken.

methods.name: testcleanup
methods.description: Tests the cleanup method for OAuthTokens.

methods.name: testdeleteByConsumer
methods.description: Tests deletion of OAuthTokens by consumer ID.

methods.name: testdeleteByUser
methods.description: Tests deletion of OAuthTokens by user ID.

methods.name: testdisplayDateFromTs
methods.description: Tests the displayDateFromTs function with various inputs.
